evidence.quotation: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current reference semantics; original MRD-057 release independently checked. Not claimed as original 2005 printed wording.

evidence.quotation: A face-down "Big Shield Gardna" can only negate a Spell Card that targets 1 face-down monster, so it cannot negate "Riryoku", "Creature Swap" or "Dark Hole", but could negate "Nobleman of Crossout" or "Tribute to the Doomed".
evidence.historicalApplicability: Goat archived FAQ; community source, not current primary Konami ruling. Named interacting cards are outside this implementation.

evidence.quotation: You cannot activate "Gravekeeper’s Watcher" when a card is discarded as a cost, such as "Magic Jammer", "Kuriboh", "Tribute to the Doomed", "Thunder Dragon", or "Type Zero Magic Crusher".
evidence.historicalApplicability: Goat archived FAQ; community source, not current primary Konami ruling. Named interacting cards are outside this implementation.

notes: Own open Main, hand/own Set; discard one other own hand card as an activation cost and target one monster on either field, including face-down. Cost is paid before response, not an effect discard; target remains until resolution after two passes. No general mixed Chain, negate, cost replacement, discard triggers or immunity.
